_inherited_budget_note: The 2026/27 budget was set by the outgoing Conservative administration (26 Feb 2026). Reform UK won 7 May 2026 (flipped from Conservative) and formed the Cabinet 21 May 2026, inheriting the budget; the first Reform-set budget will be 2027/28.

administration.note: Reform UK won the 7 May 2026 all-out election (40 of 60), flipping from Conservative control. Leader Cllr Elaine Williams (also Portfolio Holder for Finance and Governance). Part of the West Midlands Combined Authority (Mayor Richard Parker, Labour).

mtfs.intervention_status: None (no S114/EFS/BVN). DSG income GBP 197.26m; not a Safety Valve authority; cumulative High Needs deficit not published.
